name: Gin Rummy
summary: Gin Rummy is an online multiplayer card game that revitalizes the beloved classic Gin Rummy experience. Players compete to form combinations of sets and runs using a standard deck of cards, aiming to achieve the highest score while knocking to end the game strategically. The platform offers customizable rule sets and adjustable difficulty levels, catering to both newcomers and seasoned players alike. Gin Rummy can be enjoyed with friends or against AI opponents, ensuring an engaging and dynamic gameplay experience for everyone involved.
